name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT Request for the waiver of the immunity of Michał Dworczyk
part_text:
The European Parliament has agreed to lift the legal protection that Michał Dworczyk, a Polish member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. Polish prosecutors want to charge him over claims that he used a private email account for official business, including classified material, and that he later had evidence deleted. Lifting his protection lets those criminal proceedings go ahead. The Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to damage his political work.

- **What changes:** Polish prosecutors can now bring criminal charges against him.
- **Who it affects:** Michał Dworczyk, a member of the European Parliament from Poland.
- **What happens next:** The decision goes to the Polish authorities and to him.
